local.budget_revision_note: User authorized practical resource adjustment: 64 GiB project files, 35 GiB host free disk, 4 GiB host available RAM. Current cold sample is in ha.json; recheck before every phase. Historical 60 GiB receipts keep their original cap.

freshness_acceptance.credentials: Two ephemeral in-process tokens; never recorded or shared with product configuration
freshness_acceptance.host: Windows loopback collector and observer; snow-analysis NAT warehouse
freshness_acceptance.shutdown: Stop sync, preserve checkpoint, cancel synthetic job, stop realtime services and VM; verify collector continues, then close the loopback test server. Keep archives and SQLite.

ha_acceptance.shutdown: Bounded host script stops exactly matching HA containers in finally; separately stop VM. Retain volumes, topics, znodes and private config
ha_acceptance.vm_profile: ha 3072 MiB; Kafka and ZooKeeper sequential

incremental_ods.shutdown: Stop commands without deleting journal, raw archives, HDFS batches or snapshots. Review pending and landed state before resuming.

lake_acceptance.artifacts: runtime/lake/<attempt>* on host/control; control runtime/jars pinned Iceberg JAR; scale eventlogs
lake_acceptance.shutdown: Stop only scale services; retain all source Parquet, snapshots, metadata/data files and recovery evidence. No snapshot expiration or orphan deletion

lineage.shutdown: Disable optional capture or pause the DAG, export a consistent journal snapshot, stop Marquez and PostgreSQL. Preserve journal, acknowledgements and PostgreSQL volume; new backend databases require a new delivery target identity.

lite_acceptance.scope: Isolated loopback synthetic fixtures only; no shared host or business data
lite_acceptance.shutdown: Remove only the dedicated test container, unmount its unique state path and retain the image and receipts. Stop the VM when done.

model_publication.shutdown: Pause snow_models and stop project services. Preserve accepted packages, Hive metadata, HDFS tables and release history; export the latest private aggregates for offline demonstration.

optimization_acceptance.artifacts: runtime/optimization/<attempt>* on host/control; runtime/scale/eventlogs/<application> on control
optimization_acceptance.shutdown: Reuse the named scale services/driver stop; preserve source and alternate layouts, plans and event logs

realtime_acceptance.checkpoint_policy: Retain latest 3; retain external checkpoints on cancel; manual session restoration uses the same JAR hash and lane
realtime_acceptance.kafka: analysis VM NAT 9092; separate broker and volume from original CDC Kafka
realtime_acceptance.rest: VM loopback 8081; temporary verified SSH tunnel on host loopback 18081
realtime_acceptance.shutdown: Export checkpoint identity, cancel only the synthetic jobs, stop the listed containers and VM. Keep topics, checkpoint volume, database tables and archives. No automatic removal on shutdown.

realtime_scale_acceptance.artifacts: runtime/realtime-scale/<lane> on host; raw gzip, SQLite baseline, receipts, resource snapshots
realtime_scale_acceptance.host: snow-analysis only; realtime 4608 MiB VM; control and compute off
realtime_scale_acceptance.input: Verified runtime/scale/input-100k-v1 shards; original envelopes sorted only when first event/request winners are unchanged
realtime_scale_acceptance.private_previous_env: lab/secrets/realtime-before-<lane>.env on analysis VM; retain privately
realtime_scale_acceptance.resources: Reuse realtime_acceptance Kafka/Flink/Doris services and volumes, with new synthetic topics and database per lane
realtime_scale_acceptance.rest: Temporary verified SSH tunnel on dynamically allocated host loopback port
realtime_scale_acceptance.shutdown: Export checkpoint, cancel job, stop the named realtime services and always attempt soft VM shutdown. Preserve histories and inspect errors; no implicit deletion.

retirement_acceptance.artifacts: runtime/retirement/lifecycle<attempt> including state, private exports, process logs, review; runtime/lineage-interrupt/probe<attempt>
retirement_acceptance.host: Windows loopback; no VMs or business services
retirement_acceptance.process_scope: Only spawned collector/follower/probe children, loopback random port; normal collector shutdown uses private supervisor stdin
retirement_acceptance.shutdown: Close processes and retain databases, exports, log journals and removal patches. No automatic historical deletion
retirement_acceptance.worktree_ownership: Registered detached worktrees of the two product repositories, with uncommitted removal patches. Original branches and production untouched. Review through git worktree before explicit later cleanup

scale_acceptance.artifacts_and_inputs: runtime/scale on host and control VM
scale_acceptance.shutdown: Stop only the named driver, then services via tools/stop_scale_node.sh and project VMs. Preserve raw inputs, accepted packages, event logs, HDFS data and existing volumes. Do not prune or remove data on phase change.
scale_acceptance.vm_profile: scale: 2048 / 2048 / 1024 MiB; sequential startup capacity checks
scale_acceptance.yarn_logs: /snow/yarn-logs in HDFS; existing NodeManager volume log/local directories

real_data.identity: Collector instance_id and generation, Kafka cluster/topic IDs, one partition and explicit offsets; new generations require an explicit new lane
real_data.coordinator_host: snow-analysis; stage verified immutable ODS metadata to snow-control for offline computation
real_data.local_registry: runtime/real/**/.snow-real-owner.json and registered lifecycle manifests; private ignored directories only
real_data.raw_window: 7 days from original accepted_at; replicas and restores do not renew expiry
real_data.auxiliary_window: At most 30 days from original accepted_at, minimal identity/session/attribution fields only
real_data.aggregate_window: 90 days from report date; immutable managed release plus metadata-only latest pointer
real_data.sync_and_capture: runtime/real/runs/<run>/data and configured owned sync/ODS directories; original archive, pending capture, offset head and readable-window manifests
real_data.hdfs_policy: Register output and failed staging before writing; delete expired raw batches and their referencing snapshots, preserving the separate offset head
real_data.hive: snow_real database and exact registered table names; metadata is not proof that underlying partitions were removed
real_data.catalog: Versioned public page/character metadata only; declared release SHA and published/candidate state remain distinct
real_data.lineage: runtime/real/lineage/events.sqlite and acknowledged delivery copies; metadata only, no event rows
real_data.private_view: Managed data/releases/<hash>.json with 90-day expiry; real-latest.json contains only path, hash and expiry; cleanup before every read
real_data.backup_policy: Prefer aggregate/config/cursor backup. Every detail backup inherits original expiry. Unregistered VM snapshots and whole-disk copies are forbidden for real data
real_data.startup: Resource admission then registered expiry cleanup, identity checks and permit before consumers, compute or private reads; failure closes the real gate
real_data.shutdown: Stop only processes started by the current run. Preserve unexpired registered state; off does not delete all history

real_engine_epochs.host: snow-analysis only, realtime VM profile 4608 MiB; control and compute stopped during engine stages
real_engine_epochs.disk_budget_note: Analysis guest was explicitly expanded from 28 to 29 GiB for this phase and ext4 growth verified. Thin guest capacity is not host usage; the hard 64 GiB project, 35 GiB host disk and 4 GiB host available RAM checks remain. No further disk expansion is authorized by this record.
real_engine_epochs.registry: runtime/real/epochs/<epoch>/{manifest.json,compose.json,gate.json,retirement.json}; immutable writer registration and actual job receipts are separate from the startup gate
real_engine_epochs.doris_scope: snow_real_<immutable_underscore_lane>, independent user and events/daily tables
real_engine_epochs.ports: VM NAT Kafka 9092 and Doris 8030/9030/8040/9060; Flink REST only loopback 8081, access through verified SSH
real_engine_epochs.stages: storage: Kafka/FE/BE; realtime: JobManager/TaskManager only after actual storage health and remaining-memory checks
real_engine_epochs.physical_deadline: Earliest original accepted_at plus 7 days, immutable. PID1 stops at expiry and supervisor removes only fully verified owned containers and volumes
real_engine_epochs.checkpoint_policy: Minimal dedup hashes with bounded TTL; checkpoint and state volumes remain under the original epoch deadline, expired restore refused
real_engine_epochs.recovery_metadata: writer-recovery immutable chained records bind original writer/JAR/storage and each actual retained checkpoint; pause before shutdown, NO_CLAIM resume only before original expiry; incomplete recovery blocks reads/writes
real_engine_epochs.cleanup_evidence: Actual exact-object removal and absence readback, not forensic VMDK/SSD erasure; inspect all resource labels/mounts before mutation
real_engine_epochs.shutdown: restart=no; normal stop preserves unexpired volumes; startup cleanup runs before engine access
real_engine_epochs.acceptance: fixture-* physical markers and synthetic_engine_test are isolated synthetic fixtures and never authorize real reads
real_engine_epochs.synthetic_engine_receipts: engine-test/{storage.json,job.json,fixture-input.json,acceptance.json,failure.json,publication/,local-collector/}; secrets.json and job.env remain private mode 0600 and are not exported

online.existing_volume_policy: New defaults only; keep existing volume size and explicit application budget. Never resize or remove historical data on configuration change.
online.private_access: Reader-token interfaces via verified SSH loopback only; private exact summary/status and health are not exposed by the public gateway

private_ssh.scope: Dedicated key, local forwarding only; MaxSessions=0; no shell/SFTP/agent/remote forwarding. Reader token is independently required
private_ssh.shutdown: Close the owned SSH process; preserve credentials. Explicit retirement disables only this account's key/config after required exports

online.source_and_configuration: /opt/snow-statistics and /etc/snow-statistics; root-owned, private tokens separated by role
online.mount: /var/lib/snow-statistics/state.img mounted at /var/lib/snow-statistics/state; missing mount refuses startup

gateway.service: gateway in snow-statistics-edge.service; loopback-only candidate starts the gateway Compose service separately
gateway.policy: Exact public paths/methods only; strip Authorization, Cookie and identifying proxy headers; /data and /config use tmpfs

tunnel.name: snow-statistics-prod
tunnel.policy: Independent credentials and edge network; only statistics gateway ingress plus 404 fallback; existing business Tunnel unchanged

log_reader.policy: Fixed current/draining project-snow-public API labels, bounded filtered completion records; no analytics token; explicit truncation/gap counters

log_forwarder.policy: Low-privilege UNIX-socket reader, token via systemd LoadCredential, no Docker socket/group; only 202 acknowledges receipt

online.backup_and_receipts: Private /root/snow-statistics-candidates and registered original-expiry backups; installation receipts contain hashes and metadata only
online.business_dependencies: None: no business database, Compose dependency, startup/health/CI requirement or business Tunnel modification

retirement.delete: Separate explicit export and reviewed resource-specific removal. No global prune; no automatic deletion on mode switch.
retirement.lite: Stop local consumers and laboratory Compose projects; keep online collector and summary API unchanged.
retirement.off: Disable product adapters, drain accepted events, export aggregates, archive/remove public page, stop collector.
